page.overview:
What is Doppio's Stand?

Doppio's phone Stand is an unnamed Stand that is mostly featured in JORGE JOESTAR. It is similar to the original for Doppio's ability to communicate to the Boss using any object as a cell-phone.

The Stand has no true form, since it manifests in random objects. Throughout the story, the Stand takes the form of pebbles, a shoe, a light bulb, and many more. Once the Stand takes the form of an object, it will give it buttons.

Doppio's Stand is able to turn any ordinary object into a cell-phone. Using larger objects is quite difficult to use as a phone, with Doppio having to twist an actual book in order to use. When called, the phone will vibrate, creating a "Plu pon pin para para pon" sound.
